name: H. B. Wadsworth
role: Head of H. B. Wadsworth & Co. (Bad Lands Cattle Co.)
bio: H. B. Wadsworth headed H. B. Wadsworth & Co., whose herd, mostly yearling and two-year-old heifers, was the first put in on the Little Missouri below Medora. Based in Minnesota, he visited the Bad Lands Cattle Co.'s ranch in December 1884 and May 1885 and reported the cattle in good shape. In September 1885 he served on the stockgrowers' round-up committee, and while overseeing a beef shipment at Dickinson he fell from a caboose and broke his leg.
